body: Continuing the backlog loop while the SHANKPIT/S144-02 research agent ran in the background, found Section 132's own stated goal ('ensure every repo has GitHub Actions CI') had 3 real gaps among repos created/touched later than that section: GTA7, EDIS, SKULDMARK. GTA7: new ci.yml, JDK 21 + mvn package + jar artifact upload (no test suite exists -- real gameplay verification needs a connected client, honestly noted as out of CI's reach). EDIS: new ci.yml with two real jobs -- Go (go build + go test over internal/dis/cmd/dis, both passing locally before writing the workflow) and a PHP syntax-check job (php -l across all 17 plugins/+themes/ files) -- which found and fixed a real, previously undetected PHP parse error: themes/goblindragon/index.php had an unescaped apostrophe in 'What's Happening in the City' breaking out of its single-quoted string, verified clean via php -l after the fix. SKULDMARK: new ci.yml (go vet + go test), committed but not pushed -- no GitHub remote exists yet for that repo, same gap GOLDENBAND had at its own S144-01, needs the founder to create emilyspringerton/SKULDMARK. Honest caveat on all three: no gh CLI or GitHub API token available in this environment, so none of the three workflow runs could be watched executing on a real runner the way earlier CI work this session was -- the underlying build/test commands were verified locally instead (GTA7's mvn wasn't available locally either, flagged as unverified beyond local pom.xml correctness). GTA7 commits 23d1390/6f6427a, EDIS commits 9e24ef2/712e73e, SKULDMARK commits 67ff78e/0e51ffa.
title: S132: closed the last 3 repos missing GitHub Actions CI
